recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5571 unless a future terminology-wide policy requires explicit caseSensitive=true on unrelated helper code systems that currently omit the element.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PC WG DSTU1 change request asking that the questionnaire-question-text-type and questionnaire-text-type code systems not be case insensitive; the approved resolution was that codes are case sensitive.
initial_application: Commit 8668fd7cf601088670fe9b57d485549099f0bdd8 (#5571: mark as case sensitive) changed both affected old ValueSet definitions from caseSensitive=false to caseSensitive=true. Commit e4f5c0d73d001a82fba48ff47d65a7154166c19c later removed those obsolete files during the questionnaire/SDC refactor.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current core source and the FHIR Extension Pack contain no questionnaire-question-text-type or questionnaire-text-type canonical URLs. Current Questionnaire-family CodeSystems checked under source/questionnaire and source/questionnaireresponse do not carry caseSensitive=false; the main active code systems explicitly use caseSensitive=true. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later relevant decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested case-sensitivity correction was applied in 2015 and the affected old code systems are no longer in the current build.
